May 8, 2018 - By Marie Mckinney
Kenneth Mario Garschina decreased its stake in Alibaba Group Hldg Ltd (Call) (BABA) by 86.67% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Mason Capital Management Llc sold 7.80 million shares as the company’s stock rose 3.18% while stock markets declined. The hedge fund run by Kenneth Mario Garschina held 1.20 million shares of the business services company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $206.92M, down from 9.00 million at the end of the previous reported quarter. Mason Capital Management Llc who had been investing in Alibaba Group Hldg Ltd (Call) for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $501.95 billion market cap company. The stock increased 3.42% or $6.46 $195.35. About 29.86M shares traded or 61.91% up from the average. Alibaba Group Holding Limited (NYSE:BABA) has risen 68.29% outperformed by 56.74% the S&P500.
Biondo Investment Advisors Llc increased its stake in Apple Inc (AAPL) by 2.09% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Biondo Investment Advisors Llc bought 2,740 shares as the company’s stock declined 3.81% with the market. The institutional investor held 133,839 shares of the computer manufacturing company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $22.65 million, up from 131,099 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Biondo Investment Advisors Llc who had been investing in Apple Inc for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $939.50B market cap company. The stock increased 0.72% or $1.33 $185.16. About 40.89M shares traded or 11.63% up from the average. Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) has risen 19.49% outperformed by 7.94% the S&P500.
Mason Capital Management Llc, which manages about $13.63B and $1.63 billion US Long portfolio, upped its stake in Bhp Billiton Plc (NYSE:BBL) by 1.07 million shares to 3.87 million shares, valued at $156.13M in 2017Q4, according to the filing.
